description: Dunit musl port (M6) fs: cwd — getcwd/chdir over the native GetCwd/Chdir. userspace/ctests/musl_cwd.c reads the cwd (/), chdirs to /persist, reads it back, chdirs to /, reads again. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_musl_cwd_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 160 --boot-timeout 110

required.claim: the system booted to the terminal
getcwd (native GetCwd) and chdir (native Chdir, ptr+len) round-tripped the working directory
getcwd/chdir work through the ported libc
